description: He wears an ivory ankle-length tunic with a narrow open neckline, long sleeves and gold geometric embroidery along the collar, front and cuffs. A long dark copper-brown coat hangs open over it, with extensive gold floral patterning and broad geometric borders at the front, cuffs and hem. A wide brown-and-gold woven sash wraps the waist, with a knotted end and fringed hanging panel. Several rings are visible on his hands. Dark brown closed leather shoes have subtle gold embroidery across the toes.
